summary.name: UI Verify
summary.one_liner: UI Verify is a visual regression testing service that screenshots Playwright, Storybook, or Vitest UI tests on each pull request and uses an AI judge to label changes as intended, regressions, or flakes.
use_cases: Catch unintended UI regressions in pull requests
Let a coding agent detect and fix visual breakage
Review screenshot diffs of Storybook stories
Add visual tests to existing Playwright end-to-end suites
Compare UI screenshots across Chromium, Firefox, and Safari
summary.what_it_does: UI Verify captures screenshots of every component or page rendered by a team's Storybook, Playwright, or Vitest browser tests, or by custom uploaded PNGs, on each pull request. It snapshots only the screens a change touches and carries the rest forward. An AI judge classifies each visual change as an intended update, a real regression, or a flake, and gives its reasoning. Reviewers can comment on changes and accept or deny them, and the check holds the merge until changes are accepted. An MCP server lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex list builds, inspect diffs, and accept or deny changes.
notable: AI judge labels each visual change as intended, regression, or flake, with reasoning
MCP server lets coding agents review and fix visual diffs
Captures only screens a change touches and carries the rest forward at reduced cost
Works with Storybook, Playwright, and Vitest without a new test framework
caveats: Paid usage beyond the monthly snapshot bucket at $0.004 each; AI reviews beyond the bucket at $0.03 each
GitLab and Bitbucket are on the roadmap; GitHub only at present
Free plan pauses snapshots once the monthly bucket is used until the next cycle or an upgrade
